commit_message:
[Build] Stop CMake riscv64 defaults from clobbering test cpu-features (#24866)

platform cmake defaults were appending
--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu-features= after test variants, so the default
overwrote +xsmtvdot / VLEN. this prevents the override of an existing
cpu-features flag; prepend missing +m,+a,+f,+d,+c. and strips those from
generator --requirements=.

Towards: #24859

---------

Signed-off-by: Terence <terrencemahlatini@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
